name: archrivet
description: Review backend design decisions, missing facts and workload with your assistant.
long_description: Windows x64 experimental preview. Eight local checks, specific follow-up questions and before/after review comparisons. Rules are the default. Enable optional Laya 322M for the updated experimental model; strict accuracy gates are not met. Requires an MCPB 0.4 UV host, internet for setup and several GB of disk space. Host provider settings still apply.

enable_laya.title: Enable experimental local Laya model
enable_laya.description: Download the optional updated Laya 322M model (about 1 GB) for local CPU inference. Experimental: some incorrect approvals remain. Rules are the default.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Check model download progress and active review mode.

tools.name: retry_model_setup
tools.description: Retry an opted-in model download after a connection or disk error.

tools.name: get_review_schema
tools.description: Get eight supported checks and their exact structured inputs.

tools.name: review_design
tools.description: Start a local review of explicitly supplied design facts.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Retrieve review findings, missing information and estimates.

tools.name: compare_reviews
tools.description: Compare changed facts and findings, preserving unanswered questions.
